Redcrest Wheel.name: Redcrest Wheel
Redcrest Wheel.description: Signature move. Chest scales flare as the user wheels around one planted heel. A low fan of breath sweeps a four-meter semicircle for fire damage this turn while the user's scaled back shelters one crouching ally on the opposite side. The fan leaves an open lane. Another flame needs a full breath-hold turn. Strain: severe.
